output.title: How I Get My Best Ideas and Capture Them with Obsidian
output.description: A YouTube video idea on where I get my best ideas—dog walks, spinning, shower, yoga—and how I capture them with Obsidian.
output.body:
I want to create a YouTube video showing how I get my best ideas. Some examples: walking with my dog, exercising (like spinning), relaxing under the shower, or doing yoga.

Most importantly, I have a workflow to capture and dictate ideas with Obsidian. I then catch all the ideas in that workflow. For those two documents on my site, Park.
